verdict.rationale: All MCP-related evidence describes Elicit exposing its own capabilities via an MCP *server* (elicit-docs-28, elicit-docs-35) so other clients like Claude Desktop can call Elicit's tools — the opposite of the story, which asks whether a user can plug external MCP servers into Elicit so its agent can use their tools. No evidence shows Elicit acting as an MCP client or supporting user-added external tool servers.
